observed.text: The canonical active queue contains no frontier_research-owned item.
Prior Frontier work implemented an evidence transition gate but did not standardize research claim-state manifests.

inferred.text: Without a manifest contract, research artifacts can preserve provenance while still mixing observed, inferred, proposed, superseded, and unresolved claims.

proposed.text: Require the research evidence manifest before a Frontier queue item can be marked complete.

unresolved.text: The committed Node test has not yet been observed in CI or a clean checkout.

falsification.test: Attempt to encode a research result with a missing claim category, unknown source reference, duplicate claim identifier, or unknown falsification target.
falsification.failure_condition: The manifest is accepted despite any of those defects.

verification.method: Schema inspection plus six deterministic committed fixtures.
limits: Runtime execution was not available through the GitHub connector.
JSON Schema format validation depends on the downstream validator implementation.
The contract does not establish scientific truth; it makes epistemic state and falsification routes explicit.
